findings.summary: Mixed output_index presence changes text-block identity mid-lifecycle.
findings.failure_scenario: content_part.added with item_id msg_7 and output_index 7 followed by output_text.delta for msg_7 without output_index emits start/stop at 7 and restarts at sequential index 1 instead of retaining index 7.

findings.summary: Signature-only reasoning can overlap an active text block.
findings.failure_scenario: An active text block at index 5 followed by signature-only reasoning at index 2 starts and stops thinking before stopping text, producing overlapping blocks and out-of-order closure.

resolution: Do not apply r01. Mint a corrected immutable revision with adversarial regressions for both stream sequences and repeat independent review.
